lxc_9e87016c72d40804.text: A small maze can become a busy place.

lxc_c9893f250b820f31.text: Follow the basic actions, then explore the early games and the famous home party classic.

lxc_3fcb56ea5a911c8d.text: Bomberman is a series of maze and action games.

lxc_da9b72da3e21cdd8.text: A maze is a place with paths and walls.

lxc_5f7c26fac3555ce1.text: You move your character along the paths and put down bombs.

lxc_a355cde3c084485e.text: The bombs break soft blocks, which are blocks you can destroy.

lxc_50e2cf5b14627c6a.text: This opens more space to move.

lxc_014238a4b830df65.text: You can also find a power-up, an item that gives you extra help.

lxc_3e6e4cbde50b76f8.text: For example, it can make your bombs stronger.

lxc_6fb0e8f66258090b.text: But stronger bombs can be dangerous for you, too.

lxc_7db5b2357ca86cee.text: Your own blast can catch you.

lxc_e6ac36c4c39619d6.text: The simple idea is to place a bomb, move away, and stay safe.

lxc_fb9e4fda0e789417.text: Popup: Bomberman | A long-running video game series about moving through mazes and placing bombs.

lxc_eb0505aec9a6df1b.text: Popup: power-up | An item in a game that gives a player extra help or a stronger ability.

lxc_9a28baf40f9f0ca9.text: The maze is a grid, with spaces in rows and columns.

lxc_b1b680d0a401fd4f.text: You move through the open spaces and drop a bomb.

lxc_c80b8dc30308e82c.text: The bomb pulses for a short time, then sends flames left, right, up, and down.

lxc_e7f810a20b2e246b.text: The flames do not travel in a circle.

lxc_6b128e620c737ea5.text: Soft walls can break in the blast.

lxc_a046cc4565c0eb5a.text: Items may appear, and you can pick them up.

lxc_fcd247e3674faa71.text: Some power-ups let you place more bombs.

lxc_3533f99c4723f87f.text: Others make the flames reach farther.

lxc_6854459570f1b64e.text: One bomb can also set off another bomb.

lxc_593de4ae619dbfa6.text: Watch the paths before you move, not just the space beside you.

lxc_de90b16a2f860457.text: Popup: grid | A pattern of spaces arranged in rows and columns.

lxc_390283dcefee65c8.text: Popup: chain reaction | A series of events in which one event starts the next.

lxc_88f36bb4fd0bd38b.text: Hudson Soft was a Japanese video game company that created the series.

lxc_7587976df57803bb.text: The first game was called Bomber Man and came out in July 1983.

lxc_fd39e76d453d3d05.text: Another name for that first game was Bakudan Otoko, meaning “Bomb-Man.”

lxc_d0a76e29e557e930.text: Bomberman came to the Nintendo Entertainment System, or NES, in 1985.

lxc_839bf3dfcf9b514b.text: People often mean this early home version when they talk about the original classic.

lxc_19d0967b70341c91.text: So the first release and the familiar early home game have different dates.

lxc_c98dc32a029ea09c.text: The series continued for many years.

lxc_4aa863ad674fbc80.text: Multiplayer, which means playing with other people, became a key part from the TurboGrafx-16 game in 1990 onward.

lxc_a7f294b04fc79585.text: It was a game for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, or SNES.

lxc_1b943f8251704454.text: Players often remember it as a home multiplayer classic in the series.

lxc_ca7fd31229c180e2.text: Its Battle Mode allows up to four players to play together.

lxc_ca27d60c82a4df0c.text: More than two human players need a multitap, a device that connects extra controllers.

lxc_65d940095de7a8d3.text: Players move around a maze with soft blocks, collect power-ups, and try to catch each other with bombs.

lxc_d2a6b3e6f8db7982.text: Opening a path can help you, but it can help another player, too.

lxc_7ae9477f1e993be3.text: This mix of simple rules and shared danger makes it famous for party play.
